split.original_F7_spent_holdout: indices 96..127 (32 worlds); previously used by F7; not independent

encoding.source: actual state_before4 and executed_action0or1, never state_after or reward in features
encoding.base_key: [1, tanh(pre_i/scale_i), one-hot action0/1] / sqrt(sum squares); scales=[2.4,3.0,.2095,3.5]; first seven of original P80 16D key
encoding.targets: first 4 P80 tanh((state_after_i-state_before_i)/scale_i) normalized physical deltas; no reward and no padding
encoding.event_mask: event_ids 2..96 inclusive per world; no future effect in key; 95 scored steps
encoding.fixed_action: not an interactive policy, no true counterfactual or test-time action

arms.linear7: all 7 base features -> 4 delta targets, 28 scalar weights
arms.quadratic35: 7 linear + all 28 upper triangular pairwise products i<=j; 35 -> 4, 140 weights
arms.shuffled_action: fixed seed 1823999 shuffles action labels in original FIT train ONLY; uses original correct pre-state and observed target; same training/selection/test split; compares false action-credit

training.solver: weighted ridge normal equations in float64, no gradient training
training.selection: minimum 16-world original-FITdev MSE; tie smallest lambda; fit on all first 96 worlds after selection; no heldout selection
training.linear_pred: X@W, no output clamp/tanh; same supervised targets
training.regularization: lambda * I including constant; weights for each training action record 1/events_in_world
training.numerics: float64 least squares; fail on nonfinite or rank/conditioning unsupported

preregistered_metrics.primary: best selected quadratic35 and linear7 each compared to original strongest three-seed trained F7 SSM on previously consumed FIT holdout; baseline_win if either <=0.9x SSM
preregistered_metrics.secondary: linear7 vs state5 prediction MSE; >=10% improvement indicates action label predictive under observed policy, not unobserved causal effect
preregistered_metrics.negative: shuffled action FIT baseline should underperform correct action key; equality or no difference means observational action credit not established
preregistered_metrics.resource: diagnostic fit + evaluation in <=60s CPU; report full RSS / wall and parameter counts; not matched model training cost
preregistered_metrics.acceptance: Even if baseline_win, only retrospective DEV observation; SCIENTIFIC_PASS always false.

negative_controls: original ZIP and source capture SHA256 admission before evaluation
original source IDs, event receipts, event order, nonfinite and 128x96 count, terminal status and source pins
not using state_after/reward/future outcome as model input
action-shuffle control does NOT alter physical outcome label
no state-changing simulator calls; no owner runner or workflow edits
all fitted weights closed-form solely on already consumed FIT train
if baseline wins, do not infer independent transfer; compare original 3-seed training cost caveats

qualification.engineering: exact final SHA full native G4 Win/Ubuntu, G5 both, G7 Ubuntu; no new source workflow
